content:
Today, Apple TV has released the trailer for the fifth season of its award-winning children's mindfulness animated series "Stillwater." You can watch it below.

"Stillwater" returns on August 21

A few days ago, Apple TV confirmed the premiere date for the fifth season of "Stillwater," with all five episodes dropping on the same day, August 21.

According to Apple TV, the new season of "Stillwater" will feature more "breathing exercises, mindfulness moments, and simple everyday rituals," continuing to help children and families find inner peace.

"Stillwater" originally premiered on Apple TV in 2020. It has since won Daytime Emmy Awards in the Preschool Animation category as well as a Peabody Award in the Children's/Youth Programming category.
